questions.q: In Vietnam and other Berne countries, copyright arises…
options: Automatically when the work is created in a fixed form
Optional, but useful as evidence of ownership
The right to be named as author and to protect the integrity of the work
Reproduction, distribution, adaptation and communication to the public

questions.q: A logo used to identify a brand is mainly protected as a…

options: The appearance or shape of a product
Performers, producers of recordings and broadcasters
An international copyright treaty based on automatic protection

options: Is no longer protected and is free to use

questions.q: CC BY means you may use the work…

options: You may share it only on social media
Adaptations must be released under the same licence
You may share it only unchanged

options: Free if you credit the source
Allowed only with permission or a suitable licence, unless clearly public domain
Differ for desktop, web and app use
Do not exist, fonts are unprotected

options: Plagiarism is presenting others' work as your own (ethics); infringement is using protected work without permission (law)

A visible or hidden mark identifying the owner and discouraging misuse
Limited uses without permission, such as quotation, teaching or personal study, with attribution

A US doctrine weighing purpose, amount and market effect

options: Is fine if you tag them
Is fine on a private account
